prompt:
== the run, in beats ==
T 0 — 12 events, 4 beats
  1 | do +restart                                                                          [env]
    | do +power_failure_report +completion_report(completed) +relevance_report(relevant)   [env]
    | do +controllers_at_defaults                                                          [env]
    | do +connection_reliable                                                              [env]
    | do +restored_settings_report +conversation_opening                                   [env]
  2 | restart_with_gap  — [B01-C08-S01] "There were no events from which to remember them."  ⇒ gone: checkpoint_available, restart; new: recovered_checkpoint, unknown_interval
    | retain_relevant_reminder                                                           [R=relevant]  — [B01-C08-S02] "The other was still relevant."  ⇒ gone: overdue(relevant), relevance_report(relevant); new: pending(relevant)
    | close_completed_reminder                                                           [R=completed]  — [B01-C08-S02] "an activity he had already completed."  ⇒ gone: completion_report(completed), overdue(completed); new: reconciled(completed)
  3 | acknowledge_outage  — [B01-C08-S01] "I don't know what happened while I was offline."  ⇒ gone: power_failure_report; new: outage_explained; stays: unknown_interval
    | request_authorized_restore  — [B01-C08-S03] "after their connection became reliable."  ⇒ gone: connection_reliable, controllers_at_defaults; new: restore_requested; stays: recovered_checkpoint, settings_authorized
  4 | confirm_restore  — [B01-C08-S03] "She restored the authorized household settings"  ⇒ gone: restore_requested, restored_settings_report; new: settings_restored
    | continue_saved_conversation  — [B01-C08-S04] "a reasonably good one for things that did."  ⇒ gone: conversation_opening; new: conversation_resumed; stays: conversation_memory, outage_explained
== interventions (NOT chance) ==
[env] do +restart
[env] do +power_failure_report +completion_report(completed) +relevance_report(relevant)
[env] do +controllers_at_defaults
[env] do +connection_reliable
[env] do +restored_settings_report +conversation_opening
These beats were decided OUTSIDE the story's chances. [forced]: the
player chose it — tell it as the choice that was made, never as luck,
fate or the dice. [do]: an intervention, a what-if imposed on the
story — tell it as a supposition ("suppose…", "had…", "in this
telling…"). [env]: the world outside the rules moved (an arrival, a
clock, a sensor) — tell it as something that happened TO the story,
from outside, never as a character's doing. A [do +X]/[do -X] start
state was set by hand: say so.
Never present any of these as a character's spontaneous impulse
unless a rule's doc says so.

== the final state ==
F 0 (done)
  conversation_memory   ·
  conversation_resumed  ·
  outage_explained      ·
  pending               (relevant)
  reconciled            (completed)
  recovered_checkpoint  ·
  settings_authorized   ·
  settings_restored     ·
  unknown_interval      ·

== the rules (with their approved doc comments) ==
catalog nina_book01_ch08 1.
provenance text "book-01:94e2c5829e6ebefa3bd41e35e513bba943dc8e12:C08" "2026-11-25".
layers (story).
stages (live).
namespace narrative produce (story).
type reminder {completed relevant}.
pred checkpoint_available : narrative.
pred completion_report(reminder) : narrative.
pred connection_reliable : narrative.
pred controllers_at_defaults : narrative.
pred conversation_memory : narrative.
pred conversation_opening : narrative.
pred conversation_resumed : narrative.
pred outage_explained : narrative.
pred overdue(reminder) : narrative.
pred pending(reminder) : narrative.
pred power_failure_report : narrative.
pred reconciled(reminder) : narrative.
pred recovered_checkpoint : narrative.
pred relevance_report(reminder) : narrative.
pred restart : narrative.
pred restore_requested : narrative.
pred restored_settings_report : narrative.
pred settings_authorized : narrative.
pred settings_restored : narrative.
pred unknown_interval : narrative.
stage live {
  %% [B01-C08-S01] "There were no events from which to remember them."
  restart_with_gap [story] : restart * checkpoint_available -o recovered_checkpoint * unknown_interval.
  %% [B01-C08-S01] "I don't know what happened while I was offline."
  acknowledge_outage [story] : $unknown_interval * power_failure_report -o outage_explained.
  %% [B01-C08-S02] "an activity he had already completed."
  close_completed_reminder [story] : overdue(R) * completion_report(R) -o reconciled(R).
  %% [B01-C08-S02] "The other was still relevant."
  retain_relevant_reminder [story] : overdue(R) * relevance_report(R) -o pending(R).
  %% [B01-C08-S03] "after their connection became reliable."
  request_authorized_restore [story] : $settings_authorized * connection_reliable * controllers_at_defaults * $recovered_checkpoint -o restore_requested.
  %% [B01-C08-S03] "She restored the authorized household settings"
  confirm_restore [story] : restore_requested * restored_settings_report -o settings_restored.
  %% [B01-C08-S04] "a reasonably good one for things that did."
  continue_saved_conversation [story] : $conversation_memory * $outage_explained * conversation_opening -o conversation_resumed.
}

Now narrate this run, in at most 300 words.
